terms.sectionFiveBody: Ouiboo respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects its users to do the same. If you believe content on Ouiboo infringes your copyright, file a report on our copyright report page. Your notice must identify the copyrighted work, the allegedly infringing material and where it appears on Ouiboo, your contact details, a good-faith statement that the use is not authorized by the owner, its agent, or the law, and a statement, under penalty of perjury, that the information is accurate and that you are the owner or authorized to act on the owner's behalf. We review valid notices promptly and remove or disable access to infringing material, and we terminate the accounts of repeat infringers. If your content was removed in error, you may file a counter-notice through the same page and we will restore the content unless the original reporter files a court action. Our designated agent information will be published here when registration is complete.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms outline how you can use Ouiboo to plan and book your adventures.
terms.sectionOneBody: Create a profile, discover trips, and book experiences in a respectful way.
terms.sectionTwoBody: Keep your login details safe and let us know if you notice unusual activity.
terms.sectionThreeBody: Review trip policies before booking and contact support if plans change.
terms.sectionFourBody: We are here to help via email.
terms.sectionSixBody: OuiBoo provides support by email and replies to normal requests within 48 hours. During an active trip, the agency organising your trip is your first contact for on-the-day problems; its emergency contact is shown on your booking. If the agency does not respond during the trip period, OuiBoo support will escalate with the agency on your behalf. OuiBoo does not operate a 24/7 hotline. When a refund is due, the agency must complete it within 7 days of the refund case opening; OuiBoo monitors the deadline and chases overdue refunds.
terms.sectionSevenBody: Every trip shows its cancellation scale before you pay, and the same scale is repeated in your booking confirmation. If the agency cancels your trip, or a trip cannot run because its minimum group was not reached, you are refunded 100% of what you paid and the refund must be initiated within 7 days. If you cancel, your refund follows the trip's scale: the earlier you cancel before the trip starts, the higher the percentage refunded. Refunds are paid by the agency you booked with — Ouiboo is a technology platform and never holds your money.

support.title: Support
support.intro: How to reach us — and who to contact first when something happens during your trip.
support.contactsSubtitle: Keep these handy for your trip. During the trip, your agency is your first call — OuiBoo is the escalation if they don't respond.
support.agencyFirstBody: For anything during the trip — meeting point, delays, a problem on the day — contact your agency first. They run the trip and can act immediately.
support.noAgencyContact: This agency hasn't published an emergency number yet. Message them through OuiBoo, and if it's urgent during your trip, escalate to OuiBoo below.
support.escalationBody: If the agency doesn't respond during your trip dates, email OuiBoo support and we will chase the agency for you. Escalation is monitored during active trip periods — it is not a 24/7 hotline.
support.normalBody: For everything else — bookings, payments, refunds, your account — email us at {{email}}. We reply within {{hours}} hours.
support.normalLine: Anything else? Normal support replies within {{hours}} hours.
support.emergencyBody: While your trip is running: first call your agency's emergency contact — you'll find it on your booking page. If they don't respond, email OuiBoo support and we will escalate with the agency during your trip period. Outside trip dates, everything goes through normal support.
support.refundsBody: When a refund is owed, the agency has {{days}} days to complete it and OuiBoo chases it if it slips. You'll get an email as soon as a refund case is opened for you, and you can follow its status in your bookings.
support.complaintsBody: To complain about a trip, an agency, or OuiBoo itself, email {{email}} with the subject "Complaint" and your booking reference. Complaints are answered on the normal support timeline.
support.safetyNote: If anyone is in danger or needs urgent medical help, contact local emergency services first — then your agency.
support.normalBodyNoEmail: For everything else — bookings, payments, refunds, your account — your booking page carries your agency's contact and, during your trip, the OuiBoo escalation route. We reply within {{hours}} hours on the normal support lane.
support.complaintsBodyNoEmail: To complain about a trip, an agency, or OuiBoo itself, use the contacts on your booking page and mention your booking reference. Complaints are answered on the normal support timeline.
support.helpCentreBody: Search the frequently asked questions or open a support ticket — your ticket is recorded and answered on the normal support lane.

bookingConfirmation.answer: You pay the agency directly by bank transfer and upload your payment proof from your booking page. Your booking is confirmed once the agency confirms the transfer arrived in its bank account — accepting the proof alone does not settle the booking.
bookingConfirmation.question: How is my booking confirmed?

complaint.answer: Open a ticket below with the Complaint category and your booking reference, or email support if an address is shown on the support page. Complaints are answered on the normal support timeline.
complaint.question: How do I make a complaint?

normalSupport.answer: Normal support replies within {{hours}} hours. There is no 24/7 hotline: during an active trip, your agency is your first call and Ouiboo is the escalation.
normalSupport.question: How quickly will support reply?

paymentProof.answer: It is the receipt or screenshot of your bank transfer to the agency. Upload it from your booking page so the agency can match your payment to your booking and confirm it against its bank account.
paymentProof.question: What is a payment proof?

paymentRejected.answer: The agency could not match the proof to its bank account. Check the reason shown on your booking, upload a corrected proof, or open a ticket below and we will chase it for you.
paymentRejected.question: My payment proof was rejected — what now?

refundStatus.answer: You receive an email as soon as a refund case is opened for you, and you can follow its status any time in your bookings.
refundStatus.question: How can I follow my refund?

refundTiming.answer: Refunds are paid by the agency directly — Ouiboo never holds your money. The agency has 7 days to initiate your refund once a refund case is opened, and Ouiboo chases it if it slips.
refundTiming.question: How long does a refund take?

tripEmergency.answer: First call your agency's emergency contact — you will find it on your booking page. If they do not respond, contact Ouiboo support and we will escalate with the agency during your trip period. If anyone is in danger, contact local emergency services first.
tripEmergency.question: Something is wrong during my trip — who do I call first?
